# netactuate_router_vrf_dhcp (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages the DHCP service in a cloud router VRF. The interface it serves must hold an address inside the DHCP subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_vrf_dhcp" "example" {
  enabled      = true
  interface_id = 12345
  router_id    = 12345
  subnet       = "192.0.2.0/24"
  vrf_id       = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not DHCP is enabled at all.
- `interface_id` (Number) You may restrict the DHCP service to a specific interface.
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `subnet` (String) The subnet for your DHCP service to assign IPs.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF.

### Optional

- `client_domain_name` (String) The domain for search suffixes in DHCP.
- `default_router_address` (String) The IP address for the default router in your DHCP subnet.
- `do_ping_check` (Boolean) If true, prevents giving out an IP address if it already responds to ICMP pings. Defaults to true.
- `domain_name_servers` (Block List) The DNS servers provided by the DHCP service to clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--domain_name_servers))
- `lease_timeout` (Number) The lease timeout in seconds. Defaults to 86400 (24 hours).
- `ntp_servers` (Block List) The NTP servers provided by the DHCP service to clients (IPv4 addresses only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ntp_servers))
- `range` (Block List, Max: 1) The range of IP addresses that can be leased. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--range))
- `static_routes` (Block List) The static routes provided by the DHCP service to clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--static_routes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--domain_name_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domain_name_servers`

Required:

- `address` (String) The IP address of the DNS server.


<a id="nestedblock--ntp_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ntp_servers`

Required:

- `address` (String) The IPv4 address of the NTP server.


<a id="nestedblock--range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `range`

Required:

- `first_address` (String) The first IP address allowed to be leased within the subnet.
- `last_address` (String) The last IP address allowed to be leased within the subnet.


<a id="nestedblock--static_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Required:

- `network` (String) The network to route traffic towards.
- `next_hop` (String) If you want to route to an IP, you provide it here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_vrf_dhcp.example 12345
```
